blurb: Captain Patrick Gould offers full and half-day fishing charters in Naples, Marco Island, and the 10,000 Islands. Guests can fish for species like tarpon, snook, redfish, trout, shark, and more in various habitats including backwaters, nearshore, and freshwater Everglades. Private eco tours, shelling, dolphin watching, and family-friendly fishing experiences are also available.
